title: Product Categories
subtitle: Group products and services. System categories cannot be edited or deleted.
noBusinessDesc: You need to create or select a business before managing categories.
noStoreDesc: Select a store to manage categories.
noCategoriesDesc: Add your first category to get started.
lockedTitle: System categories cannot be edited or deleted
deleteMessage: This will permanently remove the category.
inUseMessage: {code} - {name} is referenced by existing products and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead?
toggleDeactivateMessage: Are you sure you want to deactivate '{name}'? Existing products keep their category, but it won't appear in the picker for new products.
toggleReactivateMessage: Are you sure you want to reactivate '{name}'?
codeHint: 2-10 uppercase letters. Used as the prefix for product codes (e.g. SV000001). Cannot be changed once created.
inactiveHint: Inactive categories won't appear in the category picker on new products.
nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters.
descTooLong: Description must be at most 500 characters.
duplicateByCode: A category with this code already exists: {code} - {name}. Open it from the suggestion list above to edit.
duplicateByName: A category with this name already exists: {code} - {name}. Open it from the suggestion list above to edit.
